API.apply: apply(proposal, engine, res, history, claims, aging, owner_assert) -> COMMITTED receipt; Main only under existing aging.lock. Caller must pin source/QA and save returned proposal bytes before apply.
API.prepare: prepare(root, engine, res, history, policy, scope_path, claims) -> immutable-ready proposal; READ ONLY
API.reconcile: Reinvoke apply with SAME proposal after a partial file/q failure, preserving lock and HOLD new admission until closure. No new grant/refund; pre-existing file pairs must be exact old/new bytes.

authority_callback: No engine/registered/canonical/forecast/authority calls. Pure passed-q identity plus file/claim CAS only.
important: This is not a scheduler wrapper. Main must run before decision under same aging lock; retain failed transaction proposal and HOLD new admission if interrupted. Never call prepare from inside authority EX.
